The survey nūl/nūlu/nol/nōḷ/noolɨ responses are narrowly selected thread reflexes with source vowels and laterals retained; the unrelated crush/broken-rice article3728 is not used. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1120 gives Tamil kaṭalai, Malayalam kaṭala, Kannada kaḍale and related southern gram names. The survey kadala/kadale groundnut responses are a modern extension of that pulse noun; preserve groundnut rather than relabelling the referent Bengal gram. Homepage comparison also attests Kannada kaḍalekāyi groundnut under this family, but no ancient Dravidian word for the introduced crop is claimed. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Survey ulli/uḷḷi/ul onion are direct lexical comparisons; the article also compares Sanskrit ūlī and Oriya uli, but does not specify an immediate borrowing route for these records.
